difficulty_reason: Producing a good module mapping onto a given one with prescribed cycles: for every triple (U, k, x) with a local cycle x the author builds phi_x : A_U[-k] -> M|_U sending 1 to x, passes to the adjoint psi_x : j_{U!}A_U[-k] -> M, checks degree and differential by hand, and combines the direct sum over all triples with the map from lemma-supply-good to obtain the required surjection on cycles. Retained author proof at lines 3052-3095.
